224:t_1:87.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...To think I'd hear those words here too...」

224:t_1:88.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Do you know something about it?」

224:t_1:89.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I believe Miss $$ミレーヌ$$ has already given you the outline of our battles on Earth, but...」

224:t_1:90.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In the course of them, we were told over and over about a collapse of the universe that occurs once every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:91.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That it is a rebirth of the universe, and that $$バアル$$ emerge in step with it... is that right?」

224:t_1:92.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Oh, $$バアル$$... The natural enemy of intelligent life, recorded even in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ texts...」

224:t_1:93.en:
$$マックス$$
「According to Advisor $$エキセドル$$'s research, even the arrival of energy lifeforms from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$...」

224:t_1:94.en:
$$マックス$$
「...was probably caused by the dimensional distortion from that collapse of the universe, the one that comes once every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:95.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「However, it appears that a collapse of the universe hasn't actually occurred...」

224:t_1:96.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「That is correct. As far as my research goes, due to disasters on a scale that shakes spacetime and abnormal outbreaks of $$バアル$$...」

224:t_1:97.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「the extinction of various intelligent species, or their decline as a species, has been confirmed, but at the very least it could hardly be called a collapse in which everything is lost.」

224:t_1:98.en:
$$マックス$$
「Even so, it's certain that something happens once every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:99.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And that it could bring about the destruction of us humans as well...」

224:t_1:100.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Exactly. The universe may not perish, but the future of the living beings who inhabit it is not guaranteed...」

224:t_1:101.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「And the growing frequency of $$バアル$$ outbreaks indicates that the crisis that comes once every 12,000 years is drawing near.」

224:t_1:102.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The enemies beyond human understanding that we encountered on Earth... those who called themselves gods said the same thing.」

224:t_1:103.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「In response, what we should do now is gather the information our predecessors left behind.」

224:t_1:104.en:
$$マックス$$
「This ship has left the fleet and is operating independently for the sake of that investigation.」

224:t_1:108.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

224:t_1:109.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So that's why we're joining an expedition team to investigate the collapse of the universe.」

224:t_1:110.en:
$$パーラ$$
「More important than that, isn't getting back to Earth supposed to come first?」

224:t_1:111.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, how long it would take, even by folding, isn't something we can answer that easily.」

224:t_1:112.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「To run those calculations, we'd have no choice but to rely on the $$マクロス７船団$$, which has data on this area, but issues like the required energy remain.」

224:t_1:113.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Even if we clear all that, we'd need to prepare for the next fold after every fold, so getting back to Earth would be a journey measured in years.」

224:t_1:115.en:
$$パーラ$$
「But Captain $$ガムリン$$ and the others, and the $$フロンティア船団$$, got thrown all the way to Earth in one go, didn't they?」

224:t_1:116.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That was a special case you can only call a mystery of the universe. It's not something human power can do anything about.」

224:t_1:118.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's okay, $$ティファ$$. It might take time, but there's a way to get home, you know.」

224:t_1:121.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I can't explain it well, but... I'm scared...」

224:t_1:123.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Could it be that you're sensing something about the planet we're about to go investigate...?」

224:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even so, we've got no choice but to go. If we're told the universe is going to perish, we can't just not look into it.」

224:t_1:125.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Exactly. The end of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years is a grave problem for us as well.」

224:t_1:126.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That being the case, we'll cooperate with $$バトル７$$'s operation, and while it's not exactly a reward, we'll have the fleet support our return.」

224:t_1:127.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Well, I suppose we are the right people for it. During the $$時獄戦役$$, $c had plenty of chances to come into contact with that sort of thing.」

224:t_1:128.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If we combine it with the information we have on hand, we might be able to learn something.」

224:t_1:129.en:
$$レド$$
「So the destination is the planet that's supposed to have $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

224:t_1:130.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Quit making that sour face, $$レド$$! Treasure is waiting for us!」

224:t_1:131.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$ピニオン$$, you're getting way too carried away. It's not a treasure hunt.」

224:t_1:132.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you talking about?! Treasure sleeping in places like that is just how it works!」

224:t_1:134.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I know all about it, $$ロラン$$. That mustache doll of yours was dug out of a mountain where old stuff like that is buried, too, right?」

224:t_1:136.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But you know, I'm no $$ピニオン$$, but it really is a little exciting.」

224:t_1:137.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Right. And if this helps us learn a bit about the mysteries of the universe, that'd be fantastic.」

224:t_1:138.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Aren't you going back to $$バトル７$$, $$ミレーヌ$$?」

224:t_1:139.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'm part of $c now, after all. As long as I know Papa, Mama, and the fleet are safe, that's enough for me.」

224:t_1:140.en:
$$アルト$$
「As expected of $$バサラ$$'s partner. You go at your own pace no matter where you are.」

224:t_1:141.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Something about how you said that bugs me...!」

224:t_1:142.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Now, now, $$ミレーヌ$$. The ruins are presumed to be the same type as the ones on $$惑星ラクス$$, so we'll need your power.」

224:t_1:144.en:
$$シン$$
「The $$プラント$$ diva became the galactic diva?!」

224:t_1:145.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course not, you two...」

224:t_1:146.en:
$$フォウ$$
「What is this $$惑星ラクス$$? And what's this about needing $$ミレーヌ$$'s power?」

224:t_1:147.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「《$$惑星ラクス$$》 was a planet with $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins. It doesn't exist anymore, though...」

224:t_1:148.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「To open the sealed door in the ruins there, they needed me, with both $$ゼントラーディ$$ and Earthling blood.」

224:t_1:149.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins demand proof of peace... That is, the mixing of blood between different races.」

224:t_1:150.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If we're talking about that, isn't the multiverse even more amazing?」

224:t_1:151.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's true. Not just various planets, but all kinds of worlds exist mixed together, after all.」

224:t_1:152.en:
$$シン$$
「...But encounters like that also give rise to wars...」

224:t_1:153.en:
$$キラ$$
「Maybe that's how it is now... But from here on, it might not be.」

224:t_1:155.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$キラ$$ is right. We're at war now, but from here on we might go on to build peace together.」

224:t_1:156.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「My own Papa and Mama were ace pilots on opposite sides, Earth and $$ゼントラーディ$$, in $$第一次星間大戦$$, but...」

224:t_1:157.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Afterward they got married and had my big sisters and me.」

224:t_1:158.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Two who were enemies got married, huh...」

224:t_1:160.en:
$$アルト$$
「But I hear Captain $$マックス$$ and Mayor $$ミリア$$ were on the brink of divorce at one point...」

224:t_1:161.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Don't throw cold water on a nice story!」

224:t_1:162.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Cut him some slack, $$ミレーヌ$$. That's just the kind of guy he is.」

224:t_1:164.en:
$$シェリル$$
「We've got one more added member for the expedition team.」

224:t_1:166.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Not me. The one going is $$ランカ$$-chan.」
